newsitem.title: UK: Sainsbury's Bank ups savings rate.
newsitem.headline: Sainsbury's Bank ups savings rate.

text.p: Sainsbury's Bank said it has increased the rate it pays on its Instant Access Savings Account to 6.15 percent gross per annum from 5.75 percent on all deposits.
The bank is a joint venture between retailer J. Sainsbury, with 55 percent, and Bank of Scotland, which has 45 percent.
Sainsbury's Bank said that since its launch on February 19, it has opened 250,000 accounts with 400 million stg in deposits.
In addition to the Instant Savings, the bank also offers credit cards and personal loans and plans to launch mortgages this summer.
